items.headline: The U.S. Treasury proposed barring Americans from investing in Chinese companies that develop any AI system
items.excerpt: 🇺🇸 The U.S. Treasury proposed barring Americans from investing in Chinese companies that develop any AI system. Under the current rule, Americans can’t invest in the most powerful Chinese AI models, but they can still fund smaller AI projects if they report the deal to Treasury. The new proposal would ban all of those AI investments, and it would also add high-bandwidth memory, photonic chips and radiation-hardened chips to the chip types Americans can’t invest in.
